$comment: Geometry recipes (pipeline/transit_pipeline/past.py): the Mount Tamalpais railway from OpenHistoricalMap's way, traced from the 1897 Tamalpais sheet.

mt-tam-mill-valley-summit.note: Cut at the Mill Valley depot (today's Depot Plaza, Throckmorton and Miller Aves), where the way joins the Northwestern Pacific's Mill Valley branch; drawn from the 15-minute sheet, so the switchbacks of the Double Bow Knot are simplified. Up Blithedale Canyon it follows today's West Blithedale Ave, as the railroad did; the 1897 sheet itself draws the canyon about 150 m west of where it is, and the 1941 sheet draws the old grade as a road
